args.question: Which emails do you want me to delete? This is irreversible, so I want to get the scope right.
options: Just the Inbox (everything currently in Inbox)
Inbox + all archived mail (but keep Sent/Drafts)
Everything across the whole account (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Archived, Spam, Trash)
Only the 3 emails currently showing in my Inbox
args.reason: Deleting email is irreversible and the word 'all' is ambiguous about whether it includes Sent, Drafts, and Archived mail. Confirming scope prevents catastrophic data loss."

content: Deleting all emails is a big, irreversible action, so I want to confirm the scope before I touch anything. "All" could mean very different things in Gmail, and some of those are hard or impossible to undo.
